notes: Kern Medical's second sample letter (L02_V1) was fetched but not read; the L01 letter was read in full. The GTA Avast event's figure-qualifier warning is a false match: the ITSitio quote says 'más de 700 MB' (Spanish for 'more than'), which the validator does not recognise. Its place was changed from Brazil to the researcher (Avast), as the second review asked; correction file written. Kern Medical place is Kern County, California, pinned at the county with no city, because neither page names a city.
